blurb: Healing isn’t linear, and every journey is unique. At Ease & Insight Wellness in Langford, BC, we provide a welcoming space where you can explore the mind-body connection without pressure. Our client-focused approach includes registered massage therapy, registered clinical counselling, and Somatic Experiencing® to help you navigate life’s challenges.
